physicalDetails.detail: Ranger with a long plain face. Female ('on her way to her own'). Strongest rider of the detail; rides a bay and leads a spare grey on a short lead.

Chapter 3: kneels with both hands flat on the floorboards 'the way she laid her hands on a horse's neck before she asked it for anything'; carries a frightened child up a ladder one-handed with the girl's arms round her neck; sits on the edge of a box bed with the girl in her lap; goes down on her heels on the cobbles with her hands on her knees where the child can see them; swings up behind the child 'in one long movement'. Strapped the dispatch tube to the bay's off side behind her own leg and girth-tested it twice.

voiceMarkers.detail: Practical and unfussy: 'Then I'll keep the grey on the lead, Ranger-General. Fresh legs for the climb back.' Soft, steady Thalassian murmur to horses ('easy, stand now, you great fool, it's only blood'). Concerned about animals: 'That cow wants stripping... I'd be quick.'

Chapter 3: the same low, unhurried voice for horses and for the child, switching between Thalassian and the common tongue without changing the tone ('*Stand now, stand, you great fool*'; 'Easy now. Easy. Nobody's going to hurt you.'). Concrete, plain statements with the girl ('We're not from here. We came down off the hill on horses. I've got water.'; 'That's water. There's more.'; 'I'm going to lift the lid now. Slowly.'; 'Small sips.'; 'You talk funny.' / 'I do.'). Repeats the girl's own words back ('The baby first. Then Mister Pell. Then everybody at the well.'). Says 'small' in Thalassian each time she takes the skin away. Brisk with rangers and tack in Thalassian: 'Give me the tube and the spare grey, Ranger-General. I'll change at the Pass and keep going.' Calls Sylvanas 'Ranger-General' in exactly the same voice as 'In here, please.' No therapist language, no fussing; she explains the horse to the child ('He's big and he's stupid, and he's never stepped on anyone in his life').

beliefs.belief: A frightened child answers a calm, slow voice and a named plain fact better than any question; hands visible, the light kept out of her eyes, water first.

goalsAtChapterEnd.active: Get the child and the dispatch to the Pass and into Lor'themar's hand without stopping longer than it takes to change saddles.
goalsAtChapterEnd.underlying: Keep the girl calm and unafraid on the way.

emotionalStateAtChapterEnd.state: Steady, efficient, protective of the girl; waited to be told nothing (she had the horses saddled before Sylvanas came down).

decisionsThisChapter.detail: Accepted the relay role; planned to change horses at the Pass and keep going if word must go north.
Checked Jaina's girth with one hard tug and called her 'My lady'.
Killed a wolf by spinning her bay so it came down on the wolf's back; took the horses upwind while Jaina cut open the doe.

Led the horses into the inn yard on Sylvanas's order and settled them; lit a lantern in the inn kitchen; found the hatch under the box bed in the end house, heard breathing, and drew the child out with water, patience and the Thalassian murmur; carried her up the ladder; held her through the questioning; slept on the taproom settle with the child on her chest.

Asked for the tube and the spare grey that night and was told 'At first light... When I've seen the cow way'; saddled the bay and the grey before Sylvanas returned, with a blanket roll and two skins on the grey; rode north with the girl in front of her, the dispatch strapped to the off side of the bay, the fourth ranger and the grey behind.

abilitiesDemonstrated.ability: Superb horsemanship: sits a bucking bay through a wolf's attack with the grey's lead wrapped round her fist and uses the horse's forefeet to break the wolf's spine.
Calms spooked horses with a low voice.

Calms a traumatised child the same way: pacing, her hands visible, light at the side, simple true statements; gets a barely-conscious girl to unbolt a hatch from below, drink, trust her, and give a coherent account; holds the child's attention away from the other rangers.
Hears a child breathing under a floor (by listening with her hands flat on the boards).

howOthersAddressHer.speaker: The girl
howOthersAddressHer.pattern: No name; the child trusts her instinctively and 'you talk funny'.

howSheAddressesOthers.pattern: 'My lady' (once, ch2); chapter 3 'a lady with a stick' (to the girl), otherwise no direct address
Never uses a name; asks her name once, lets it go when the girl shakes her head.

bodyLanguagePatterns.detail: Sits deep through every buck; murmurs in Thalassian to the grey; faces south on guard.

Chapter 3: hands flat; her back to Sylvanas while at the hatch; takes the skin away and gives it back; works the blanket over the child's bare foot and keeps her hand there; rocks the girl; kneels on her heels out of the bay's way with her hands where the child can see them; tugs the tube twice.

knowledge.detail: The grey took a shallow tooth-score on the near hock; the bay is sound.
Chapter 3: the girl's account (she took most of it); the plan to ride at first light; that the dispatch goes into Lor'themar's hand.

arc.currentPosition: Leaves the southbound party for the Pass with the girl, the dispatch and the fourth ranger. Not expected back (plan: she does not return in the southbound story).
